name: refuse-after-fix-caller
description: An after-fix refusal the CALLER can act on itself: the projector emits an isError result whose text leads with the code, carries outcome 'refused' plus the refusal and nothing else, and exposes no _meta. This is the only fixBy class an agent may retry on its own.

refusal.message: the requested model is not among those this app may use
refusal.fix: pick a model the app is allowed to use and call again with the same handshakeId
